name: fix81_party_animals
verifies: fix-81 #1/#3 (fix-106: no look-out of his own, CP AssessActivePerception skips the hostile step for NPCs led by the player): Gorn in the party joins the wolf fight once the wolves attack him or land a bite on the hero (AssessAgressor / AssessFightSound) within 10 s; a scavenger (Angry to humans, Neutral for him) is attacked as soon as its bite lands on the hero (AssessFightSound -> PlayerCommand); the hero hits a wolf once, Gorn kills it and the hero gets its XP (G3 Kill: XP once when the killer is the player or a member he leads)
steps: spawn Wolf dist=10 side=front count=2 as=w
log Gorn fights $w or its pack mate
spawn Scavenger attitude=hostile dist=3 side=front as=s
notes: 'fighting:Gorn' turns True when a wolf attacks him (he fights back) or the fight sound of a bite on the hero engages him (fix-106: companions have no look-out). The hero's single hit leaves the wolf alive (fight hp=400 secs=1.5); 'hp $w 3' makes Gorn's next blow the killing one. xp>0 needs the party kill to pay (fresh hero has 0 XP). The scavenger is spawned hostile, so it bites the hero at once; Gorn is Neutral to scavengers and joins on the first landed bite.
